summary: Client UI (Noesis) one-frame event: for every remote-player view-model object removed from the VMRemotePlayerDataSingletonComponent collection, the registration system creates a fresh entity carrying this component with the object pointer, so UI code can drop it; gui::vmplayer::VMPlayerUnregisteredCleanupSystem reads it. Same pattern as Script Extender's VMInventoryUnregisteredOneFrameComponent / VMCombatUnregisteredOneFrameComponent. Never seen alive (no seen.py samples).

fields.name: Object
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x12A9BD0 (AllocRaw 8) writes 0 and registers destructor bg3.exe+0x1207D80, which calls the Release slot (+0x20 of the virtual table at +0x10 of the pointee) on *this: an intrusive Noesis::Ptr. bg3.exe+0x12A8B60 (per-frame update of gui::registration::VMPlayerRegistrationSystem, step 2/2, lines ~406-440) takes each object out of a Noesis::BaseCollection, creates an entity, adds this component and stores the pointer (AddRef slot +0x18 / Release slot +0x20). Value type presumably Noesis::Ptr<gui::VMRemotePlayer> (the Data singleton's value type), written as void* like SE's VMInventoryUnregisteredOneFrameComponent::Object.
